observed_round1: Half/full projection reduced clean RMSE versus v5 by 2.08%/2.40%, but worsened fault RMSE by 0.71%/1.89%; both rejected by the preregistered 0.5% cap. No gate is relaxed.
rationale: The fast adapted unobserved acceleration is held indefinitely when both wheels disappear. Test bounded exponential relaxation toward the calibrated physics after trusted pair age exceeds max_age_s. A fixed 2-second time constant is a hypothesis, not a fitted physical fact; this may fail on sustained gradients. Keep all outcomes.
acceptance: UNCHANGED from round1: >=2% clean OR >=5% fault gain vs v5, <=0.5% clean/fault regression, <=1% scalar-distance regression, per-bag clean <=max(0.005m/s,5%), no coverage/false-stop/recovery/causal regression; actual ROS and offline checks before promotion.
data_policy: Only the same 19 validation bag measurements; adaptive reuse, not an independent test. No reading/rerunning final-test measurements. Same matching, baselines, metrics and fault positions.
search_limit: These are the last three hypotheses in this task. Select only a passing measured candidate; otherwise use the preregistered v5/v4 fallback. No tuning against final test.
intermediate_publication: Plan, patch, per-bag results, rejected outcomes and final promotion decision go to GitHub; main stays unchanged until verified selection.
